meeting_request.description: 会议邀请 / Requesting a meeting
meeting_request.subject: Meeting Request: {topic}
meeting_request.body:
Hi {name},

I hope this email finds you well.

I would like to request a meeting to discuss {topic}. Would you be available sometime next week? Please let me know what days and times work best for you, or feel free to share your calendar.

Looking forward to our discussion.

Best regards,
{sender_name}

follow_up.description: 跟进事项 / Following up on a previous conversation
follow_up.subject: Following up: {topic}
follow_up.body:
Hi {name},

I hope you are having a great week.

I am writing to follow up on {topic}. Could you please provide an update when you have a chance?

Let me know if you need any further information from my side.

Best regards,
{sender_name}

status_update.description: 项目进度更新 / Providing a project status update
status_update.subject: Status Update: {project_name}

thank_you.description: 感谢信 / Thanking someone for their time or help
thank_you.subject: Thank You: {topic}
thank_you.body:
Hi {name},

Thank you so much for your time and assistance with {topic}. I truly appreciate your help and insights.

I will keep you updated on the progress and reach out if I have any further questions.

Best regards,
{sender_name}

introduction.description: 自我介绍或介绍他人 / Introduction
introduction.subject: Introduction: {sender_name} / {topic}
introduction.body:
Hi {name},

I hope this email finds you well.

My name is {sender_name} and I am reaching out to introduce myself. I work on {topic/project} and would love to connect to explore potential synergies between our teams.

Would you be open to a brief chat sometime next week?

Best regards,
{sender_name}
